title: The Moldy Bread Theory
sentences: Some researchers have suggested Salem’s ‘witchcraft’ may have started with moldy rye.
The idea came from a 1976 paper by Linnda Caporael in the journal Science.
Ergot, a fungus that grows on rye, can cause spasms and hallucinations.
But later that year, two psychologists reviewed the evidence in the same journal.
They argued the symptoms and the pattern of cases did not fit.
Most Salem historians reject the theory, so treat it as a hypothesis, not an answer.
